summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to 30,000,000 shares of variable rate Series C perpetual preferred stock (CHAD Stock) through sales agent R.F. Lafferty. Sales occur from time to time at market prices; the agent earns up to 0.75% commission, with no escrow. Shares carry a $10.00 stated amount and cumulative regular dividends at a variable annual rate, payable monthly beginning October 1, 2026. CHAD trades on Nasdaq; the September 10, 2026 close was $8.07. Watch preferred overhang, dividend-rate resets, and whether proceeds fund digital-asset accumulation.
